'''Kenb''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Operations Center Commander]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Revelation" /> in [[41 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]'' to [[41 ABY]].</ref> and was present when [[Cha Niathal]] made a surprise visit for what [[Darth Caedus]] had planned for the [[Second Battle of Fondor]].<ref name="Revelation" />
